text: ユーも　おなじ　みち　たどる　ちがい　ナーイ！

structure.jp: おなじ　みち　たどる

patterns.name: 〜にちがいない
patterns.span: たどる　ちがい　ナーイ
patterns.explanation: にちがいない after a statement means 'there is no doubt that'. The speaker drops the に and stretches ない in his broken foreigner-style Japanese. たどる　ちがい　ナーイ = 'you'll surely follow it'.
